description: Source code for a firmware image creation utility, including functions for handling firmware partitions, headers, signatures, and building the final firmware image file.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Writes firmware header information into memory buffer.

methods.name: write_signature
methods.description: Writes signature data into memory buffer.

methods.name: write_part
methods.description: Reads a file, maps it into memory, and writes its data along with metadata into the firmware image buffer.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.

methods.name: print_image_info
methods.description: Prints details about the firmware image being created.

methods.name: filelength
methods.description: Returns the size of a file.

methods.name: str2u32
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: image_layout_add_partition
methods.description: Parses partition description string and adds partition info to the image layout.

methods.name: image_layout_verify
methods.description: Validates the firmware layout and partition data.

methods.name: build_image
methods.description: Constructs the firmware image file from partitions and headers.
